# Harborly — Health badges show an icon

Videos: `changelog-16x9.mp4` (1920×1080) and `changelog-1x1.mp4` (1080×1080), 15 s each.

## X

What's new in Harborly: health badges now show an icon — On track, At risk, Off track read at a glance, on the
Projects board and the dashboard. harborly.example

## LinkedIn

What's new in Harborly: every health badge now shows an icon. On track gets a check, At risk an exclamation mark and
Off track a cross, so a project's health reads at a glance — even without color. You'll see them on the Projects board
and in the dashboard's upcoming launches. Start free trial at harborly.example.

## Changelog blurb

**Health badges show an icon** — On track, At risk and Off track badges now include an icon (check, exclamation mark,
cross), so health reads at a glance on the Projects board, project pages and the dashboard.
